ValidationRule.description: Restrict Quote editing after approval if the Quote is recalled or resubmitted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Has_Bypass_Site__c, $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "API/ADMIN/NON MFA", ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(ApprovalStatus__c), "Approved"), OR ( ISPICKVAL(ApprovalStatus__c, "Recalled"), ISPICKVAL(ApprovalStatus__c, "Pending") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved Quotes cannot be recalled or Re-submitted again for Approval.
